title: Supreme Court Again Blocks Republican-Backed Missouri Voting Map
summary: The ruling deferred to the state’s Supreme Court, which had invalidated G.O.P.-friendly district lines, saying voters must first have an opportunity to approve the map in a statewide referendum.
